e.title: 风险转移与财富架构
e.summary: 风险如何被转移、财富如何被长期管理
e.body: 这条纵深线关注风险的转移与长期财富管理。它由 [[rim530]]（再保险与风险转移）与 [[rim531]]（寿险与养老）构成，覆盖 [[reinsurance]]、[[insurance-linked-securities]]、[[longevity-risk]] 与 [[actuarial-present-value]]。
e.body_en: This track concerns risk transfer and long-term wealth management, spanning RIM530 (reinsurance and risk transfer) and RIM531 (life and pension insurance).
e.body_hk: 這條縱深線關注風險的轉移與長期財富管理。它由 [[rim530]]（再保險與風險轉移）與 [[rim531]]（壽險與養老）構成，覆蓋 [[reinsurance]]、[[insurance-linked-securities]]、[[longevity-risk]] 與 [[actuarial-present-value]]。
e.summary_en: How risk is transferred and wealth managed over the long term
e.summary_hk: 風險如何被轉移、財富如何被長期管理
